meta.assembleiaDescricao: Vote anonymously on the learning paths the semester should prioritize, fill in the Semester circle and run the assembly in your hub.
meta.ouvidoriaDescricao: Send a question, criticism or suggestion to the ombudsman without an account, and follow the public answer with your reference number.
meta.educadorDescricao: The monthly recognition of someone who teaches at the School, only with permission, with no ranking and no photo.

emRevisao: Text under review: written by the package, not yet approved by the coordination.

assembleia.lead: Every semester the coordination publishes an agenda of learning paths. People who study mark up to {n} of them, without identifying themselves, and the coordination reads the result to decide what to prioritize.
assembleia.proposta: Proposed agenda, to be confirmed by the coordination.
assembleia.estadoFechada: Voting for this semester is closed.
assembleia.estadoSemPauta: The coordination has not published this semester's agenda yet. Meanwhile, fill in the Semester circle and take it to your hub.
assembleia.estadoOutro: The published agenda is for semester {semestre}. This semester's agenda is not out yet.
assembleia.pautaTitulo: The agenda: mark up to {n} paths
assembleia.comoVota: The vote is anonymous: the server adds one point per path and does not know who voted. This device only keeps which paths you marked, so you do not go over {n}.
assembleia.avisoVoto: Note: a vote cannot be undone. Because the server only adds up and does not know who voted, there is no way to remove a vote later.
assembleia.entendi: I understand: a vote cannot be undone
assembleia.votado: Your vote for this path was marked
assembleia.esgotou: You have already used the {n} votes of this semester.
assembleia.naoGuardou: This device does not keep marks (storage blocked), so the vote was not counted.
assembleia.foraDoAr: Voting is offline right now; try again later.
assembleia.naoEEleicao: This is a count of devices, not an election: one device may belong to more than one person and whoever clears their data can mark again. The coordination reads the result and decides.

resultado.poucos: Few votes so far. The numbers appear when there are more votes, so it does not look like a poll with very few people.
resultado.indisponivel: The result is unavailable right now.
resultado.ordem: In agenda order, not by total. No ranking of people.

roda.lead: A collective evaluation in 5 questions. Answer alone or in a circle with your hub, and take the result to the coordination or the ombudsman.
roda.p3: What would you change in the School?
roda.p4: What should be taken to the coordination?
roda.p5: What should be taken to your hub?
roda.avisoNome: This answer seems to contain a person's name. The circle carries no names: tell what happened without saying who.
roda.nadaSai: Everything stays only on this device. Nothing leaves here without your click on Send at the ombudsman.
roda.guardadas: Circles kept on this device: {n} (at most one per semester, up to 4).
roda.semAparelho: This device does not keep what you write; use Copy the text before leaving.

nucleo.titulo: Run the assembly in your hub
nucleo.lead: A hub is a group that meets to study together. This outline takes one hour and asks for nobody's name.
nucleo.p1: Agree on a time and a place (or a video call).
nucleo.p2: Read the agenda out loud, path by path.
nucleo.p3: Talk for 15 minutes about what each path would do for the group.
nucleo.p4: Note on the Semester circle sheet what came up in the conversation.
nucleo.p5: Each person votes on their own device, in their own time, without saying who they voted for.
nucleo.p6: Agree on what to take to the coordination and to the ombudsman.
nucleo.territoriosDaTrilha: Territories that already have this path:
nucleo.semTerritorio: No Territory mentions this path yet.
nucleo.nada: The School does not ask for or keep the name of a hub, a city or a list of participants.
nucleo.revisao: Outline under review: written by the package, not yet approved by the coordination.

ouvidoria.lead: A channel for a question, criticism or suggestion about a lesson, a course, an educator or the whole School. No account needed.
ouvidoria.guarda: The server keeps the subject, the page (if you give it), what you write and, if you want a private answer, a contact. Your network address and any account are not kept. Only the reference number stays on your device.
ouvidoria.quemLe: Only the mediation and the coordination read it. When an answer is published, only the mediation's summary and the answer appear in public, never what you wrote or your contact.
ouvidoria.apaga: The text and the contact are deleted 365 days after sending.
ouvidoria.eliminar: To ask for deletion before 365 days (Brazilian Law 13,709/2018, art. 18, VI), write through the contact on the privacy page quoting the reference number. [A REVISAR PELA COORDENAÇÃO]
ouvidoria.paginaAjuda: The page address on the site, like /en/trilhas/…
ouvidoria.contato: Contact, only if you want a private answer (optional)
ouvidoria.avisoDados: Do not enter ID numbers, documents, addresses, phone numbers or a child's name. If you are under 18 you may write, but without your own data.
ouvidoria.avisoEducador: Tell what happened, without insults. Only the mediation reads it, and nothing here becomes public text with anyone's name.
ouvidoria.semRoda: You have not filled in the Semester circle on this device yet.
ouvidoria.caminhoInvalido: The page address is not in the right format (start with /).
ouvidoria.foraDoAr: The ombudsman is offline right now; your message was not sent. The text is still there, try again later.
ouvidoria.sucessoGuardou: We kept the subject, the page, the text and the contact (if you gave one). We did not keep your network address. The reference number stayed on this device, in the My references list.
ouvidoria.sucessoNaoGuardou: This device could not keep the reference number; write it down elsewhere.

recusas.entrePrimeiro: For this action you need to sign in first.
recusas.contaSuspensa: This account has sending suspended by the mediation.
recusas.invalidoSobre: The chosen subject is not valid. Pick one from the list.
recusas.invalidoCaminho: The page address is not valid. Delete it or use one like /en/trilhas/…
recusas.invalidoTexto: The text must be between 10 and 3000 characters.
recusas.invalidoContato: The contact is too long (at most 200 characters).
recusas.areaInterditada: This part of the site is closed at the moment.
recusas.enviosPausados: Sending is paused by the coordination. Try later.
recusas.acessoBloqueado: This network origin was blocked by the mediation.
recusas.muitosPedidos: Too many submissions in a short time. Wait a little and try again; what you wrote is still there.
recusas.generica: It could not be sent right now. Try again later; what you wrote is still there.

protocolos.lead: The reference numbers of the messages you sent from this device. They stay only here.
protocolos.vazio: You have not sent any message from this device yet. When you do, the reference number appears here.
protocolos.recebida: Received. If the mediation publishes an answer, it appears here.
protocolos.aviso: This only erases from the device. It does not erase the message on the server, which goes out through the 365-day routine.

publicas.lead: Answers the mediation decided to publish, with a summary without names. The text of whoever wrote and their contact never appear.
publicas.vazio: There are no public answers yet. Send your question above.

educador.lead: Each month the coordination recognizes someone who teaches at the School. It is not a prize, not a position and does not count as a grade: it is a public thank-you, made only with the person's permission.
educador.regras: Only the nickname appears, which the person authorized. No photo, no ranking, no vote per person and no count of nominations. Whoever wants to leave the list asks and is removed right away, with no need to explain.
educador.vazio: Nobody is published for this month yet. Nominations arrive through the ombudsman and the coordination talks to the person first.
educador.motivoRevisao: Text written by the coordination from the nominations; under review until the coordination approves it.
educador.indicar: The nomination goes through the ombudsman, in private. Tell what the person did that helped you study.
educador.monitoriaTitulo: Want to be a mentor after you finish?
educador.monitoria: Whoever completed a course can help the next class. See how on the classes page.
